test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa2168ac4ecd2fc25256620fc3b96f9b18f57c67d15ca35d7401e4c22f8b6f04.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Letter element → The letter element shift clockwise and replaced by the next vowel subsequently.

2) Hexagon element → The hexagon element shift clockwise and is alternately shaded.

3) Heart element → The heart element is alternately shaded.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22d962c1ab3ef452ddad4412afd2488e96b356fa3a3004e981ca54c8d3151740.png] 

Thus, final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3d06a13a77c164d140522dfefcd2efae8c218b97ee19862937036d7726f4c5a.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
